rationale_md: The Netherlands enter this Group F encounter as heavy favorites, backed by a substantial 270-point Elo rating advantage over Sweden that reflects their superior recent form and squad quality. This gap translates to our model giving the Dutch nearly three-quarters of the win probability, with Sweden's chances sitting below 10%. The Oranje's dominance in the head-to-head metrics suggests they should control proceedings and collect all three points in what appears a mismatch on paper.
